Class CrusadeController

java.lang.Object
seng201.nunbutblood.controllers.CrusadeController
public class CrusadeController extends Object
Crusade Controller manages core gameplay loop.

FUNCTIONS :


setupDemonDisplay() - Takes the selected demons stats + portrait and creates a relevant info into demonContainer


refreshUI() - Updates the Saint's sanity after roll, the crusadeProgressBar, and the eventLog


handleRoll(Saint) - Rolls the dice, plays the animation, and checks for a success. Sets rollResultLabel and narrativeLabel. Then checks for if the game is over.


showEndDialog(String, String, boolean) - Transitions out of the screen declaring victory or defeat.
